message.content: Jennifer Moore provides several useful tips for managing muscle soreness in her interactions with Li Hua. One of the primary pieces of advice she offers is the importance of staying hydrated. She suggests drinking plenty of water to aid in recovery. Additionally, Jennifer recommends engaging in light activities like walking or gentle yoga, which she refers to as "active recovery." This type of low-intensity exercise can help alleviate soreness and promote circulation. Furthermore, Jennifer advises spending some time stretching the muscles post-workout, noting that stretching can improve flexibility and reduce tension. Another recommendation she gives is using a foam roller on sore spots, which she describes as a technique to help with muscle tightness. Lastly, Jennifer stresses the significance of adequate rest, stating that "don't skip on recovery days" because muscles need time to heal. These strategies are designed to enhance recovery and reduce the discomfort associated with muscle soreness.
